# Anna Vakarova

**PhD Candidate in Economics**  
University of California, Berkeley

**I am on the <u>2026–2027</u> academic job market.**

I am an economist working in microeconomic theory, with research interests in fair division and general equilibrium theory.

My job market paper studies the existence and computation of envy-free and efficient allocations in general allocation environments.

## Job Market Paper

### The Power of Sperner's Lemma in Fair Division

This paper develops a general approach to fair and efficient division that does not rely on equilibrium existence.
